citations.text: H. D. Mittelmann. Benchmark of network-LP solvers. Arizona State University.

description: The large network linear programmes (minimum-cost flow problems written as LPs) of H. Mittelmann's benchmark of LP solvers, listed from the host's directory of bzip2-compressed MPS files with each file's address and its size as the listing states it. The entry lists the files and carries none of their contents: keepset has no category for a mathematical programme yet, and graph/v1 would lose the row senses, right-hand sides and bounds a solver test needs. The grid-on-torus instances the benchmark page also reports are generated, not distributed, so they are not listed. The page reports solve times and no reference objective values.
name: Mittelmann network LP benchmark instances
